issues.problem: day values ゆうべ (last night) and 今朝 (this morning) clash with the absent values built on 昼寝 (a daytime nap), e.g. ゆうべ、子どもたちが昼寝している間に.
issues.action: Replaced ゆうべ and 今朝 with 土曜日 'On Saturday' and 日曜日 'On Sunday'.

issues.problem: trouble value 電車に乗り遅れた ('you miss your train') reads oddly with several requests (go to reception, come to the office, talk to the teacher).
issues.action: Replaced with 授業を休む 'you need to miss a class', which fits every request.
